verdict.rationale: SavvyCal exposes a real REST API (confirmed via a live OpenAPI spec with 17 paths covering scheduling links, events, webhooks, time zones) plus webhooks and OAuth/PAT auth, showing genuine API-first infrastructure. However, no evidence shows API coverage for major UI features like round-robin scheduling, workflows/automations, meeting polls, or Stripe payment configuration, so full UI/API parity is unproven. Missing for 10: API endpoints for workflows, round-robin distribution, meeting polls, and Stripe/payment management; independent confirmation of parity beyond core scheduling objects.
